Safety Is Not the Problem What Really Makes Work Unsafe Shajahan Abdul Salam · CSP, CMIOSH
New book · October 2026

Safety Is Not the Problem: What Really Makes Work Unsafe

My first book looks at the gap between how work is planned and how it is actually done on construction sites, plants and projects. Instead of blaming individual mistakes, it shows how planning, budgets, competence, leadership, supervision, schedules and commercial pressure make unsafe work likely, or make it seem acceptable.

Written for HSE professionals, supervisors, project managers, engineers, contractors and leaders who want to think critically about risk.

Innovation lab

Safety products I'm building

Turning hazards I see on site into hardware and software that protect workers.

UK Design No. 6556457 · Granted

Smart Work-at-Height Harness

Twin-leg tie-off verification & sensor module system

Sensors on both lanyard legs check, every second, that a worker at height stays tied off. If a hook opens, the module alerts with light, sound and vibration. The electronics sit outside the load-bearing webbing, so the harness keeps its certified strength.

100% tie-off monitoringIndependent channels for Hook A and Hook B during movement.
Dual microswitch checkValidates connector lock and anchor engagement on each leg.
Tri-alert outputsLED, buzzer and haptic motor when a contact opens.
Zero PPE degradationNo drilling, cutting or stitching on structural paths.
RegistrationReg. 26 Sep 2026 · Granted 07 Oct 2026

Dashboards and apps I built myself

No formal tech background, just a need for better data. These tools turned paper inspections and thick standards manuals into live insight at NEOM.

Power BI · Live dashboard

Contractor HSE Statistics

One screen for every contractor on site: manpower and man-hours by project, active permits, high-risk and night work, safety officer coverage and toolbox talk topics.

Telegram · AI assistant

SafeBot: AI Environmental & HSE Assistant

A Telegram bot I built for NEOM field teams. Ask a question in plain words, such as noise limits for night-time concrete pours or buffer zones when clearing acacia trees, and it returns the exact NEOM standard clause and page number in about two seconds.

≤ 2 sto the exact clause & page
2,300queries answered
1,150labour-hours saved
3potential fines averted
  • Cites NEOM standard sections and source pages in every answer
  • One-tap buttons to generate an NCR or log an observation
  • Commands for history, PDF export and diagnostics

Inspection Data Analysis

Breaks down every site observation by category, risk rating, location, contractor and inspector, and tracks closure status. It showed the root causes that shaped our training programs.
